title: Vertiv delivers space-saving cooling for edge applications, with new ceiling and row systems for North America
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced the expansion of its thermal portfolio with the introduction of the Vertiv™ CoolPhase Ceiling and Vertiv™ CoolPhase Row cooling solutions for edge applications. The ceiling-mounted precision cooling unit is designed for edge computing and small IT spaces, preserving valuable floor space while delivering dedicated cooling for IT equipment. The row-based cooling solution is engineered for high-density data center environments and edge applications, enabling efficient thermal management close to the heat source. The Vertiv CoolPhase Row is available now in North America, while the Vertiv CoolPhase Ceiling will launch in Q2 2026.
